title: Ph Life Insurance Handbook — 6. Bancassurance Partnership Privileges
cleaned_content:
## 6. Bancassurance Partnership Privileges
For depositors and account holders of our bancassurance partner banks (BDO, BPI, Metrobank, Security Bank):
- **Fast-Track Underwriting**: Non-medical underwriting limit increased to ₱3,000,000 face amount for applicants aged 18 to 45.
- **Auto-Debit Discount**: Zero processing charges and 5% first-year premium rebate when enrolling through bank branch referral ADA.
- **Dedicated Bank Financial Specialist**: Seamless coordination at the partner bank's local branch.
